text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик fights hard against some
formidable
opponents but fails to
emerge victorious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She accepts the results, resolving to stay

level-headed and continue improving.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, she reflects on our
hardships and
how those trials have
helped us grow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then expresses her hope to race in
the Osaka
Hai next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
